## Problem And Result / 问题与结果

Describe the concrete problem and the behavior after this change.
说明具体问题及修改后的行为。

## Model Or Rule Impact / 模型或规则影响

For geometry, route, or relay changes, identify the official edition/section and selected format. Separate rule requirements from demonstration choices. Write “None / 无” when not applicable.
几何、路线或接力变更请提供官方版本、章节及所选赛制，区分规则要求与演示安排；不适用时填写“无”。

## Validation / 验证

List commands actually run and their results. For visual, camera, or input changes, include browser/version, viewport, event, grouped-start setting, playback position, and screenshots or a recording.
列出实际执行的命令与结果。视觉、视角或输入变更请提供浏览器版本、视口、项目、分组设置、播放位置与截图或录屏。

## Related Issue / 关联问题

Link the relevant issue, if any. Note translation or documentation updates and any remaining limitations.
如有相关 issue 请链接，并说明翻译、文档更新及仍存在的限制。
